message: The other night, I decided to test our smoke alarms—just a little routine check, right? But of course, I set off a mini-commotion in the house! Instead of panicking, we turned it into a cozy event, gathering in the living room with snacks while we waited for the alarms to chill out. It reminded me how important it is to have a plan for those moments, but also how making it fun can ease the nerves. Ever turned a potential panic into a cozy moment?
